title: Event rates per 100,000 population
purpose: Turn counts of events into rates per 100,000 people (or another base), per group and period and pooled per period: the computation behind SDG indicators such as road traffic deaths (3.6.1), homicide victims (16.1.1), trafficking victims (16.2.2) and people affected by disasters (11.5.1).

rows.description: one count of events for one group in one period, with its population

per.description: the population base of the rate (default 100000)

rows.description: each input row with its rate, by period then group

periods.description: per period: groups, total count, total population, pooled rate

contract.effects: none: a pure function of its JSON input; the command reads standard input and writes standard output

sdg.basis: These indicators are counts per 100,000 population, and this function computes that step from counts and populations the caller supplies.

derived_from.shape: incident counts with a population denominator: road deaths, homicides, overdose deaths, trafficking victims

limits: The rate is crude: it is not age-standardized, and the population is taken as given for the whole period. The counts and population of a group have to describe the same area and time, which the function cannot check. Small populations give unstable rates and no interval is reported. Periods and groups sort as text.
